scope.summary: Implement the deduped descriptor/batchPlay-style path as a typed StudioCommand variant for operations not yet surfaced as a named high-level command, so no capability is unreachable from automation. The descriptor path is still typed, still receipted, still undoable, still promotion-gated; it is a lower-level entry to the same contract, never an unaudited escape hatch.
acceptance_criteria: typed descriptor path reaches unnamed ops; still receipted/undoable/promotion-gated
expected_tests: live: descriptor command executes a not-yet-named operation under receipt+undo+promotion
negative: descriptor path cannot bypass promotion gate

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Low-level descriptor path (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Capabilities unreachable from automation, or an unaudited escape hatch is introduced.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
